description: Standard linear two-layer global-mean energy-balance model using CMIP5 multimodel-mean thermal parameters reported from Geoffroy et al. (2013). This is a physically grounded reference system, not a calibrated prediction for the real climate trajectory.

parameter_provenance.interpretation: CMIP5 multimodel-mean parameters for a standard two-layer EBM; values are used as a reference fixture rather than re-estimated here
parameter_provenance.citation: Geoffroy et al. (2013), Journal of Climate 26, 1841-1857, doi:10.1175/JCLI-D-12-00195.1

forcing.interpretation: unit-response normalization; not identified with a particular historical or greenhouse-gas forcing
